verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Brevo's API lets you personalize email content per recipient with dynamic variables, including batch sends of up to 1000 personalized versions. That covers variable substitution, but nothing shows template management as code. The other template mentions are drag-and-drop and ready-made templates aimed at non-developers. missing for 10: documented template CRUD API, HTML/MJML template support, template versioning or version-control workflow, template variable syntax docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control

citations.quote: Personalize content for each recipient using dynamic variables.
Send up to 1000 personalized email versions in a single API request
